raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2". The vertical axis (Y-axis) is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, with no units specified. The horizontal axis (X-axis) is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The chart displays three data series: a blue dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", an orange dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", and a green dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33". The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 and decreases to near 0.0. The orange line starts near 1.0, decreases sharply to about 0.2, then fluctuates with minor increases and decreases. The green line also starts near 1.0, decreases sharply to about 0.1, then fluctuates slightly before ending near 0.05. All three lines are plotted against the same "Layer" axis.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This line chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", ranges from 0 to 20 with linear numerical increments of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear numerical increments of 0.2. Three data series are plotted: a blue dashed line ("sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03") that starts near 0.2, dips to near 0.0, and remains low; an orange dotted line ("sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44") that begins near 1.0, decreases sharply to around 0.2, then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.4; and a green dashed line ("sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33") that also starts near 1.0, decreases to around 0.1, and fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.2.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03”, which starts near 0.2 and remains low; an orange dotted line labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44”, which begins near 1.0 and decreases to approximately 0.2; and a green dashed line labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33”, which also starts near 1.0 and declines to approximately 0.05. All three lines show a general downward trend with some fluctuations, particularly the orange and green lines which exhibit more variability after layer 15.
raw_responses.German: The chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three different conditions: sparsity ratio before gate (blue dashed line, average 0.03), sparsity ratio after gate (orange dotted line, average 0.44), and sparsity ratio after average gate (green dashed line, average 0.33). The x-axis represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line starts at approximately 0.2 and remains near 0.0 throughout. The orange line begins near 1.0, decreases to approximately 0.2 by layer 10, then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.3. The green line also begins near 1.0, decreases to approximately 0.1 by layer 10, then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.15. All three lines show a general downward trend from layer 0 to approximately layer 10, followed by fluctuations with no clear trend.
